information.description:
Dime-a-dozen rent-a-thugs that litter NC’s streets almost more than the actual litter. They work for whoever’s paying, usually as protection detail to a location or person that needs some gun-toting mercs to hold a place down against your casual looter. Not overly powerful, but almost never operating alone.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Generics).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Everyone in Night City knows the characteristic rattle of this submachine gun. Designed in the 2040s, Militech intended the Saratoga to be a versatile piece in their corporate security arsenal. However, its advantages – small frame, light weight, relatively cheap price, ease of use and modifiability – also rendered this SMG a major hit outside the glass towers of Corpo Plaza. This is the ideal weapon for vehicular and urban combat.

Special Features: If any damage dealt by this weapon would reduce a target to under 1 HP, they are instead Unconscious at 1 HP. Once per Round when this weapon deals damage past a target’s armor, it also applies the effect of EMP Ammunition, but with a DV13 Cyberteck Check to resist instead of a DV15, and only disabling 1 piece of Cyberware. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, the Cybertech Check is increased to DV15. Whenever this weapon causes a Critical Injury and successfully applies the EMP effect, it disables 2 pieces of Cyberware.
